executive_summary: Your supply chain is fundamentally sound across all pillars, but geopolitical concentration risk warrants sustained monitoring rather than immediate action. Four suppliers (Huizhou BYD, Smoore, EVE Energy, Porton) face critical or high battery/EMS exposure tied to US-China trade and Taiwan vulnerability—these merit quarterly review and contingency mapping for export control escalation, though current medium risk levels don't demand emergency sourcing yet. A secondary cluster of three printing substrate suppliers (Stora Enso, IP Sun, Sappi) each face distinct regional shocks (NATO frontier, trade war, South African infrastructure), but their medium BAT exposure means supply loss would be disruptive rather than catastrophic. No urgent action needed now, but use the next 60 days to stress-test your China-dependent EMS and battery tier and identify at least one qualified alternate source per critical category in case Taiwan tensions sharpen or export controls tighten.
